# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Record the date, time, and location of the inspection.
4. Specify the vehicle being inspected and its registration details.
5. Note down any mechanical issues or defects with the brake system.
6. Include details on any repairs or maintenance that needs to be carried out.
7. Describe any issues or concerns related to the vehicle's braking performance.
8. Mention the presence of any warning lights or indicators related to the brake system.
9. Document the steps taken to diagnose and address the brake issues.
10. Note down any adjustments made or parts replaced during the inspection.
11. Include photographs or sketches to illustrate the failed brake system and the repairs undertaken.
12. Sign and date the inspection report to verify its accuracy and completeness.<eos>
